verdict.line: You lose if you walk straight into Gnar's boomerang poke while his Hop is up; you win if you all-in the instant his E (Hop) goes on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Gnar's entire matchup depends on E (Hop, range 475, cooldown 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s) being available — it is both his poke-reset and his escape. The 52.4% Camille win rate over 1417 games and Camille's solo-kill edge both come from the same window: the moment Hop is down, Camille's E (Hookshot) plus delayed-recast Q turns this from an even poke war into a one-sided all-in.

theirWindow.what: He can throw Q (Boomerang Throw, range 1100, slows) then bounce off you or a minion to reset distance. Don't chase through the slow — wait it out or bait the throw with a minion first.

yourWindow.what: All-in immediately: E (Hookshot, range 800) to the nearest wall for the knock-up, then hold the Q (Precision Protocol) recast a beat before firing it for the bonus damage, and stand in W (Tactical Sweep)'s outer cone to slow him and heal off the extra damage.

start.why: Runs at 50.9% over 931 games and the passive damage reduction eats into Gnar's Q (Boomerang Throw) poke before you can close distance.

boots.why: Picked in 77.5% of games (51.6% win rate over 1115) because Gnar's Q and basic attacks are both physical — Steelcaps directly blunts his poke.

core.why: The highest-win-rate first core item (54.5% over 330 games) — the burst spike turns Hookshot-engage windows into kills.
Standard second item in all three measured build paths — sustain and AoE auto damage for extended trades.
Most-picked third item (43.4% pick rate) — lets you tank Mega Gnar's R (GNAR!) burst and stay alive through the all-in.

situational.when: you're ahead and chaining repeated all-ins off E-Q resets
the enemy team has burst that threatens you once Gnar reaches Mega form in fights
you need the wave clear or sustain before Ravenous Hydra completes

runes.keystoneWhy: The permanent health growth and proc-heal directly counters a lane that's decided by chip damage from Gnar's Q poke rather than burst.

summoners.why: The top-performing pair at 53% win rate and 62.2% pick rate — Ignite converts Camille's measured solo-kill advantage into secured kills during the Hop-is-down all-in window instead of just trading damage.

playing.title: Punish Hop cooldown
playing.detail: Gnar's E (Hop, cooldown 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s) is his only engage and only escape. The second you see him use it to poke or reposition, start your all-in — he has nothing left to disengage with.

playing.title: Respect the boomerang
playing.detail: Gnar's Q (Boomerang Throw, range 1100) slows on hit and comes back to him for a cooldown refund if caught. Angle your approach so it whiffs rather than walking it down head-on.

playing.title: Track the Rage bar
playing.detail: Gnar's passive Rage builds in combat and at max grants Mega Gnar form — a new stunning W (Wallop) and a knockback R (GNAR!) that stuns anyone it slams into a wall. Burst him down or disengage before he caps Rage mid-fight.

playing.title: Delay your Q recast
playing.detail: Camille's Q (Precision Protocol, cooldown 9/8/7/6/5s) does significantly more damage on the recast if you wait between the two hits — hold it during the all-in instead of firing both instantly.

playing.title: Stand in W's outer ring
playing.detail: Camille's W (Tactical Sweep, cooldown 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) hits after a delay; the outer half of the cone slows and deals extra damage while healing you. Position so Gnar is caught in that outer band, not point-blank.

playing.title: Save E for a wall
playing.detail: Camille's E (Hookshot, range 800, cooldown 16/15/14/13/12s) only knocks up enemies on landing — fight near top lane's walls so the engage guarantees the knock-up instead of a wasted leap.

playing.title: Ult before he transforms
playing.detail: Camille's R (Hextech Ultimatum, cooldown 140/115/90/0/0s) anchors Gnar in place and adds magic damage to your autos. Use it the moment it's up at rank 3+ to lock him down before his Rage bar fills, denying the Mega Gnar transform entirely.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1) — the ability breakdowns and tactical timing calls are the author's own reading of those numbers, not OP.GG's.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Gnar’s (Q) pokes as well as his third strike when fighting him! Try to kill him when (E) is on cooldown or engage combat aggressively!
